newsitem.title: USA: PSE to list options on First American, others.
newsitem.headline: PSE to list options on First American, others.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange (PSE) said Wednesday it would list options on First American Corp, Imperial Credit Industries Inc, NeoPath Inc and Prime Hospitality Corp on October 7.
The exchange said First American options will have opening strike prices of 45, 50 and 55 and initial expirations of October, November, December and March.
Imperial Credit options will have opening strikes of 30, 35 and 40 and initial expirations of October, November, December and March.
For NeoPath, opening strikes will be 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2. Expirations will be for October, November, December and March.
Prime Hospitality options will open with strike prices of 15, 17-1/2 and 20, with expirations in October, November, January and March.
Sheldon Kahn of Pacific Coast Capital will be the market maker for the First American, Imperial Credit and NeoPath options, the PSE said.
It said Ron Goodman and Mark Weinstock of Goodstock will be the market makers for Prime Hospitality. --Derivatives desk, 312-408-8750/E-mail: derivatives@reuters.com
